subject: gk
question: Which constitutional amendment is known as the "Mini Constitution"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**42nd Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 42nd Amendment Act of 1976 is popularly referred to as the **"Mini Constitution"** due to its vast and comprehensive changes to the Constitution of India.
 
• It was enacted during the Emergency period under the leadership of Prime Minister **Indira Gandhi**.
 
• This amendment brought significant changes to the Preamble, Fundamental Rights, Fundamental Duties, and Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP).
 
• The words **"Socialist," "Secular," and "Integrity"** were added to the Preamble, redefining India's identity as a nation.
 
• It also curtailed the powers of the judiciary, giving more authority to the Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Preamble Amendments:** The terms "Socialist," "Secular," and "Integrity" were introduced to strengthen India's commitment to democracy and pluralism.
 
• **Fundamental Duties:** The amendment introduced ten Fundamental Duties under Article 51A, emphasizing the moral obligations of citizens.
 
• **Judiciary vs. Legislature:** It attempted to reduce the independence of the judiciary by limiting its power to review constitutional amendments.
 
• **Directive Principles:** The amendment gave precedence to the Directive Principles of State Policy over Fundamental Rights, emphasizing socioeconomic justice.
 
• **Emergency Powers:** It extended the duration of the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies during a National Emergency from five to six years.
